The XML text replacement failed because the birth date placeholder was likely split across multiple tags in section0.xml.
The test failed to find '1990-11-02 (35세)' in the output, as the original placeholder '{{birth_date}}' remained partially intact or incorrectly processed. Trace analysis suggests the regex failed to bridge tags like <hp:t>{{birth</hp:t><hp:t>_date}}</hp:t> despite attempts to handle split text. Future iterations must normalize XML text within <hp:run> elements or use a more robust merging strategy for placeholders.
